quests.dispatcherQuestion: Multi-zone hazmat incident with three overlapping chemical exclusion areas. Input code!
quests.hint: Set the alpha zone matrix configuration.
quests.explanation: Zone matrix protocols allow multiple hazmat teams to operate in adjacent areas simultaneously without crossing safety boundaries.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Secondary chemical reaction detected within the inner hazmat exclusion zone. Input code!
quests.hint: Issue secondary reaction code to all teams.
quests.explanation: Secondary reaction codes alert inner-zone personnel to move to a pre-designated safe sector immediately.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Hazmat commander requesting decontamination setup at the outer perimeter. Input code!
quests.hint: Set up decontamination at the outer perimeter.
quests.explanation: Outer perimeter decontamination prevents hazardous material transfer from inner responders to the public safety zone.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Aircraft declared emergency and making unplanned approach to runway 22L. Input code!
quests.explanation: Authorizing the emergency approach allows ground crews to position crash response equipment along the runway path.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Aircraft has belly-landed on the runway with gear failure and high fire risk. Input code!
quests.hint: Deploy ARFF units to the runway.
quests.explanation: Aircraft Rescue and Fire Fighting units carry specialized foam for aircraft fuel fires that standard equipment cannot manage.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Passengers being evacuated from the aircraft via emergency slides. Input code!
quests.hint: Deploy medical triage to the runway.
quests.explanation: Emergency slide evacuations can cause injuries; triage teams assess and prioritize passengers at the runway exit point.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Mass triage center being established for a regional disaster with 200 casualties. Input code!
quests.explanation: Charlie level triage deploys mobile field hospitals and coordinates specialist teams for large-scale casualty management.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Triage officers require four ambulance staging points around the perimeter. Input code!
quests.explanation: Multiple staging points reduce ambulance turnaround times and keep casualties moving efficiently to appropriate facilities.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Black-tagged casualties exceeding capacity of the current morgue staging area. Input code!
quests.explanation: Expanding mortuary capacity maintains dignity protocols for deceased victims and keeps casualty tracking records accurate.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Regional power grid failure cutting electricity to a 200 square kilometer area. Input code!
quests.explanation: Load shedding prioritizes electricity supply to critical services during a grid failure by cutting non-essential demand.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Gas power stations being brought online to compensate for the grid failure. Input code!
quests.explanation: Gas plant ramp-up supplements failing grid capacity within 20 to 30 minutes, reducing the duration of widespread outages.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Industrial customers must disconnect to stabilize the struggling grid frequency. Input code!
quests.explanation: Industrial disconnection orders cut the largest non-essential consumers first to quickly stabilize grid frequency.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Deep-sea research vessel reporting critical flooding in its lower decks. Input code!
quests.explanation: Surface rescue vessels carry specialist dive equipment for dynamic offshore recovery operations.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Crew of 14 have abandoned ship and are in survival suits in the open ocean. Input code!
quests.explanation: Search grid protocols coordinate multiple vessels and aircraft systematically to maximize the probability of locating survivors.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Helicopter locates survivors in a life raft 30 miles from last known position. Input code!
quests.hint: Deploy winch team to recover the survivors from the raft.
quests.explanation: Winch recovery from moving life rafts in open ocean requires specialist training and precision equipment operation.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: CBRN incident with mixed chemical and biological contamination confirmed. Input code!
quests.explanation: CBRN protocols deploy specialist teams for Chemical, Biological, Radiological, and Nuclear threats simultaneously.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Contaminated responders arriving at the mobile decontamination station. Input code!
quests.explanation: A second shower line doubles throughput and reduces the time contaminated responders remain potentially exposed.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Biological agent samples collected and need secure transport to a reference laboratory. Input code!
quests.explanation: Secure biological sample transport follows Class 6 hazardous material packaging rules to prevent laboratory contamination.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Electromagnetic pulse attack has knocked out communications across the city. Input code!
quests.explanation: EMP-hardened radio systems are shielded against electromagnetic interference and function after pulse attack events.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Critical infrastructure control systems offline after the EMP event. Input code!
quests.hint: Switch all critical systems to manual control.
quests.explanation: Manual control modes allow operators to manage essential infrastructure without digital control systems during outages.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Emergency services coordinating response using hardened analogue networks. Input code!
quests.hint: Switch to the analogue network channel.
quests.explanation: Analogue radio networks remain functional in EMP scenarios because they lack the microprocessors that digital systems require.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Refugee camp medical facility overwhelmed with a measles outbreak. Input code!
quests.hint: Deploy a vaccination team to the camp.
quests.explanation: Rapid mass vaccination in an outbreak camp creates herd immunity quickly and prevents measles from reaching critical spread.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Clean water supply for 10,000 camp residents has been contaminated. Input code!
quests.explanation: Mobile water purification units provide safe drinking water to large populations during humanitarian emergencies.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Cholera cases appearing in the camp and emergency sanitation is required. Input code!
quests.hint: Issue cholera response kits to the camp.
quests.explanation: Cholera response kits contain oral rehydration salts, hygiene supplies, and isolation barriers for outbreak containment.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Bioagent detector at border checkpoint triggered by an international passenger. Input code!
quests.explanation: Checkpoint isolation prevents potential biological exposure from spreading to adjacent passenger processing areas.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Suspect passenger confirmed positive for an unknown pathogen. Input code!
quests.explanation: Dedicated containment rooms with negative air pressure prevent airborne pathogens from escaping to the general terminal.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Public health rapid response team needed for contact exposure mapping. Input code!
quests.explanation: Exposure mapping identifies every person within transmission range of the positive case for isolation or targeted testing.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Space station oxygen partial pressure dropping below minimum crew safety levels. Input code!
quests.explanation: Reserve oxygen valves release stored pressurized gas to restore safe atmospheric oxygen levels for the station crew.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: CO2 scrubbing system failing on the orbital station with a crew of six. Input code!
quests.hint: Perform an emergency lithium hydroxide canister swap.
quests.explanation: Lithium hydroxide canisters chemically absorb CO2 and can be swapped manually when the automated scrubber fails.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Station commander requesting emergency undocking procedure for the Soyuz vehicle. Input code!
quests.explanation: Emergency undocking allows crew evacuation from the station if life support systems cannot be restored.
